commits.subject: Select process sandboxes during launch preparation (#62183)
commits.reason: Select and validate the process sandbox against the effective permission profile and roots on the actual execution host.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 137a0e4771d3534d7d714b1e962ec5a252e5207abe213e50c938db39859fd07d.

Launch preparation shares policy binding for local attempts and shell snapshots. Required exec-server launches still refuse a missing platform backend, and the concrete Windows paths are resolved only for that selected launcher.

Upstream source tests cover network-only restriction, workspace-relative grants for the command cwd, sibling-path denial, and the same bound target through WebSocket exec-server. Preserve ALab source and destination restrictions across retained execution.
commits.revisit: Exercise restricted operation and default policy in local and WebSocket routes, including destination workspace and network restrictions restored across native handoff.
